chunks: He was created of spurting water
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'spurting water' in Surah At-Tariq?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (86:6) is often interpreted as highlighting the humble, physical origin of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) to counter claims of his arrogance, while simultaneously affirming his divine selection. The term 'māʾ dāfiq' (spurting water) is understood not merely as semen but as a symbol of the potent, life-giving force through which the Imams and the Prophet were physically descended, linking their bodily creation to spiritual purity. This duality reinforces the Shia doctrine of the Prophet's dual nature: fully human in origin yet divinely chosen and infallible in station.
